timing: Recorded before new event/selection integrals or posteriors. Source-driven exploratory extension of already observed six-model and mixture results; not preregistration.
question: Does the observed g magnitude-model contrast survive the mass and redshift assumptions already used in the original tutorial robustness grid, after restoring all69 original-prior event sources and testing both official O3 banks?
functional: g=P(chi_eff<0), binary-level; no physical formation-channel label
redshift_model: p(z) proportional to Planck15 differential comoving volume times (1+z)^(kappa-1), 0<=z<=2.3; same saved quadrature/coordinates as the existing control
fixed: All69 original-prior source analyses, their recorded event set, prior-density reconstruction and row counts; no event or row rejection based on ESS.
Early O1/O2 semianalytic selection prescription, time/trial weights, mass-ratio power and cosmologies.
Normalized sign/even-shape spin model and its explicit2PN invariance/angle-measure approximation; g remains independent of mass and redshift in every model.
No source HDF, existing scientific result or published v0.3 artifact may be overwritten. New caches have their own protocol.
comparisons: At each fixed mass/redshift/even-shape setting, compare the two magnitude-family posterior medians; report all27 contrasts for each bank/policy, not only the largest.
For each magnitude/even-shape setting, report the full3x3 mass/redshift range of posterior quantiles. This is a declared model envelope, not a credible interval or model-averaged posterior.
At identical54-model settings compare the two related O3 banks and two policies: quantile shifts, posterior total variation and exact differences of model contrasts, without assigning significance.
Quantify target probability outside each O3 proposal support for every mass/redshift/magnitude variant, separately from any observed detected contribution or likelihood correction budget.
Report event and selection weight concentration and zero components without interpreting them as full Monte Carlo error or excluding problematic models.
independent_validation: No imports of the producer weights/posterior. Reconstruct PE prior by an independent flat-LambdaCDM integral, target densities in Cartesian source-spin coordinates, direct HDF selection sums, all69 multiplicative event factors, and support quadrature. Reuse the frozen target cosmology grid explicitly and verify all sources against hashes.
literature_position: Sensitivity to mass-spin/redshift modeling is known in the literature; the increment is this source-verified54-model conditional comparison. A factorized nuisance grid does not test general mass-spin-redshift correlations.
limits: Not hierarchical fitting of alpha/kappa, Bayesian model averaging, physical channel inference, waveform-systematic calibration, recovery of historical detection/reference protocols, or certification of prior/injection missing support. A small bank difference does not prove actual omitted sensitivity is small.
